---
title: "Statistics"
---

Earth2Studio.jl wraps verification metrics from `earth2studio.statistics` for evaluating forecast quality.

## Available Metrics

| Constructor | Description |
|:---|:---|
| `RMSE()` | Root Mean Square Error |
| `MSE()` | Mean Squared Error |
| `MAE()` | Mean Absolute Error |
| `ACC()` | Anomaly Correlation Coefficient |
| `CRPS()` | Continuous Ranked Probability Score |
| `FSS()` | Fractions Skill Score |
| `Variance()` | Variance |
| `Mean()` | Mean |
| `SpreadSkillRatio()` | Ensemble spread-skill ratio |
| `RankHistogram()` | Rank histogram (reliability) |
| `BrierScore()` | Brier Score (probabilistic binary) |
| `LogScore()` | Logarithmic scoring rule |
| `ReliabilityDiagram()` | Reliability diagram data |

## Usage

Construct a metric with reduction dimensions, then call it on forecast and observation data:

```julia
metric = RMSE(reduction_dimensions=["lat", "lon"])
score = metric(forecast_da, observation_da)
```

## Custom Metrics

Construct from any `earth2studio.statistics` function name:

```julia
metric = Statistic("rmse"; reduction_dimensions=String[])
```
